speak: You press send max. But what happens when the fee comes from that same balance?
caption: You press send max. But what happens when the fee comes from that same balance?

speak: On Arc, the money and the gas are the same USDC. Every transaction needs a network fee, paid from the balance you're sending. Try to send every cent, and nothing is left to pay for it.
caption: On Arc, the money and the gas are the same USDC. Every transaction needs a network fee, paid from the balance you're sending. Try to send every cent, and nothing is left to pay for it.

speak: LastDollar shows what you can actually send, what the fee may cost, and what remains, before you approve anything.
caption: LastDollar shows what you can actually send, what the fee may cost, and what remains, before you approve anything.

speak: This is the live app on Arc mainnet, with real USDC. I am connected with MetaMask, using a small wallet that holds about three cents. I will send its maximum to my other wallet.
caption: This is the live app on Arc mainnet, with real USDC. I am connected with MetaMask, using a small wallet that holds about three cents. I will send its maximum to my other wallet.

speak: I choose Send maximum, and native USDC. LastDollar estimates the real transaction, sets aside a maximum fee budget, and offers everything else. The estimated fee is what it will probably cost. The budget is the most it can cost.
caption: I choose Send maximum, and native USDC. LastDollar estimates the real transaction, sets aside a maximum fee budget, and offers everything else. The estimated fee is what it will probably cost. The budget is the most it can cost.

speak: Because the real fee is usually below the budget, a tiny amount stays behind. LastDollar says so up front, instead of promising an empty wallet.
caption: Because the real fee is usually below the budget, a tiny amount stays behind. LastDollar says so up front, instead of promising an empty wallet.

speak: Before anything is signed, I confirm the recipient and the amount. When I continue, LastDollar rechecks my balance, nonce and fees. If anything changed, it would ask me to review again.
caption: Before anything is signed, I confirm the recipient and the amount. When I continue, LastDollar rechecks my balance, nonce and fees. If anything changed, it would ask me to review again.

speak: Then I approve the payment in MetaMask.
caption: Then I approve the payment in MetaMask.

speak: Confirmed. LastDollar reads the receipt from the chain. The recipient got exactly the reviewed amount, and the actual fee, less than a twentieth of a cent, stayed inside the budget. What is left in the wallet is the unused part of that budget.
caption: Confirmed. LastDollar reads the receipt from the chain. The recipient got exactly the reviewed amount, and the actual fee, less than a twentieth of a cent, stayed inside the budget. What is left in the wallet is the unused part of that budget.

speak: Anyone can check it on the Arc explorer. The proof page lists the mainnet payments, and re-verifies each one live from the chain, in your browser.
caption: Anyone can check it on the Arc explorer. The proof page lists the mainnet payments, and re-verifies each one live from the chain, in your browser.

speak: LastDollar is open source, with a TypeScript SDK so other Arc apps can use the same checks. Try it at lastdollar dot vercel dot app.
caption: LastDollar is open source, with a TypeScript SDK so other Arc apps can use the same checks. Try it at lastdollar.vercel.app
